messages:
Sasha: Hey CS — handing off Silverpine integration (signed SOW yesterday). Primary ask: CS to own onboarding & coordinate with Eng for a Private VPC deployment. TL;DR below, owners and next steps requested.

Sasha: Context: mid-market fintech, compliance-heavy, wants per-tenant VPC + KMS. Expected GA traffic: ~50 rps, spike to 200 during batch jobs. They need SSO (SAML) + webhook callbacks to internal systems.

Mohit: Thanks Sasha. Adding context and flagging renewal risk: contract 12mo, auto-renew after 9mo unless adoption >X. I'll take day-to-day CS lead. assigning tasks now.

Mohit: Action owners I'm proposing:
- CS lead: Mohit (onboarding plan + enablement)
- Eng: Jordan (network & infra readiness)
- Support: Anya (post-go-live runbook + escalation path)
Can you confirm Jordan + Anya? @Jordan @Anya

Jordan: Yep I can take infra. Quick heads-up: private deploy will need dedicated subnet prefixes and a NAT for outbound ops. Also need Customer's IP allowlist for callback endpoints. Can you share their expected CIDR + SAML IdP metadata?

Sasha: Sending assets shortly — attaching in DM, but core items:
- SAML metadata URL: https://silverpine.example/idp/metadata.xml
- Preferred CIDR: 10.241.0.0/16 (they can expand later)
- KMS: they prefer AWS KMS (account xxxxx).

Mohit: Cool. I'll create the onboarding plan doc and a short enablement checklist for the CSM <> Eng handoff. Two-week runway: week 1 provision + SSO test, week 2 smoke + pilot.

Anya: I'll own the runbook and support SLAs. Can we add a post-go-live 30/60/90 adoption check cadence? I want to capture feedback from their PM and engineering during pilot.

Jordan: Sounds good. I'll start infra tasks tomorrow. Est. provisioning time 3 business days once we have CIDR + KMS ARN. Also FYI we have a known issue with NAT gateway timeouts on bursty webhook loads — will add caching/fanout recommendation to design.

Sasha: Noted. I'll push the CIDR + KMS ARN to the thread when I have it (ETA EOD). Thanks for the quick replies. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Support ticket created: #SP-ENV-4721 (network provisioning) — assigned to Jordan.

Mohit: OK next steps (owners):
- Sasha: share CIDR + KMS ARN + IdP test account (due EOD today)
- Jordan: start infra ticket & provide provisioning checklist (due +3bd after assets)
- Anya: draft runbook + escalation matrix (due +5bd)
- Mohit: onboarding plan + pilot checklist (due +2bd)
I'll run a 30-min handoff call tomorrow 11am PT. If any blockers raise here.

Anya: +1 for the call. I'll add calendar invite and include PM from Silverpine.

Sasha: Invite accepted. Sharing assets now. Thanks team.

Mohit: :eyes: Following up after call — will post meeting notes and owners in this thread for reference.
